facts.fact: 忧郁：像酒鬼喝酒般喝血、吃器官其实是在吃情绪；想念 Marcela
facts.anchor: You drink blood like an alcoholic drinks wine. You eat vital organs when really you’re just eating your feelings.

facts.fact: 七天实验：第四晚新皮肤、第五晚给 Marcela 注蝙蝠 DNA、第七晚置于天花板洞下等闪电；Bride of Chimotera 复活

facts.fact: 婚礼当晚村民再袭；Bride 举火把『It's not natural』；两人相拥自焚 THE END
